headlines.title: 李 “골 깊으면 산 높을것 ” 증시 정상화 개혁기구 지시
headlines.summary: 빨간 넥타이 매고 한국거래소 찾아 이재명 대통령이 13일 서울 영등포구 한국거래소에서 열린 ‘자본시장 정책 간담회’에서 발언하고 있다. 취임 후 두 번째로 거래소를 찾은 이 대통령은 이날 간담회에서 “자본시장 정상화는 우리 정부의 확고한 정책 방향이고 의지”라고 밝혔다. 김재명 기자 base@donga.

headlines.title: 월급방위대 본격 가동 …월세·근로장려금 늘리고 돌봄·자산형성 지원

headlines.summary: 정부, 3차 주택공급 정례브리핑 "서울 상승률 둔화·매물 증가세" 토허제 연장 관련 "모니터링 중" 12일 서울 시내 한 부동산에 전세 및 매매 등 매물 정보가 게시되어 있다. 뉴스1 정부가 서울 아파트 매매가격 상승세가 둔화하고 매물이 늘어나는 등 부동산 시장의 하향 안정 흐름을 보여주는 지표가 확대되고 있다고 진단했다.

headlines.title: [단독] " 보증금 없이 월세만 " 日기업 한국 상륙
headlines.summary: 월세시장 지각변동 일본 임대료 보증업체 제이리스 韓 진출 임박 세입자는 신용심사 받는 대신 목돈 부담 덜어 전세에서 월세로 빠르게 바뀌고 있는 한국 임대차 시장에 일본식 월세 보증 서비스가 상륙할 전망이다. 임차인의 월세 지급 능력을 심사해 보증을 서고 월세가 밀리면 보증회사가 임대인에게 대신 지급하는 방식이다.

headlines.title: 반도체 메가프로젝트 전력 · 용수 에 10년간 84조…국고만 58조

headlines.title: 구글 고정밀 지도 반출 조건 충족… 내년 초 국내 지도 시장 경쟁 본격화
headlines.summary: 정부, 고정밀 지도 반출 보안조건 이행 확인 티맵과 데이터 가공 협력… 내년 초 길찾기 기능 강화 국내 지도업계, 공정경쟁·서비스 고도화 강조 정부가 13일 구글의 고정밀 지도 국외 반출 보안조건 이행을 확인하면서 이르면 내년 초 구글의 국내 지도 서비스가 강화될 것으로 전망된다. 사진은 영국 런던의 구글 사무실 외부에 설치된 로고.

headlines.title: 20년 만에 '구글지도' 국외반출 허용
headlines.summary: 내년 구글 길찾기·내비 서비스 정부가 구글에 1 대 5000 축척 고정밀 지도의 국외 반출을 허용했다. 이에 따라 이르면 내년부터 국내에서도 구글 지도의 길 찾기와 내비게이션 서비스를 이용할 수 있을 것으로 전망된다. 국토교통부와 관계부처, 민간 전문가로 구성된 ‘기본측량성과 국외반출 협의체’는 13일 구글의 보안 조건 이행 결과를 최종 승인했다.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Mega Project Requires 84 Trillion Won for Power and Water Infrastructure Over 10 Years
key_headlines.summary: The South Korean government estimates that 84 trillion won will be needed over the next decade for power and water infrastructure to support mega semiconductor projects, with 58 trillion won coming from government funding.

key_headlines.title: Japanese No-Deposit Monthly Rent Guarantee Company Enters Korean Market
key_headlines.summary: Japanese rental guarantee firm J.Relis is entering Korea to offer deposit-free monthly rent services, allowing tenants to avoid large upfront deposits through credit checks while the guarantee company covers missed payments.

key_headlines.title: President Lee Vows to Stabilize Capital Markets with Sweeping Reforms
key_headlines.summary: President Lee Lee-myung visited the Korea Exchange and pledged that capital market normalization is a firm policy direction, instructing establishment of a reform task force to restore market stability.

key_headlines.title: Government Launches 'Salary Defense Squad' to Support Living Costs and Asset Building
key_headlines.summary: The government initiated an inter-agency task force to reduce household living expenses and increase disposable income for workers, focusing on five areas including livelihood costs, childcare, and asset formation.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Housing Market Shows Signs of Stabilization with Slowing Price Growth
key_headlines.summary: The government reported that Seoul apartment prices are rising at a slower pace and inventory is increasing, indicating a downward stabilization trend in the real estate market ahead of planned housing supply measures through Q1 2026.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economic agenda is heavily focused on mega projects and housing market stabilization. The government unveiled plans requiring 84 trillion won for semiconductor mega project infrastructure over a decade, with 58 trillion won in government funding. President Lee pledged to normalize the capital market through comprehensive reforms. A government initiative called the 'Salary Defense Squad' was launched to ease household financial burdens by increasing monthly rent support, childcare assistance, and asset-building programs. The housing market is showing initial signs of stabilization with Seoul apartment price growth slowing and inventory increasing.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's economy continues steady growth with October employment increasing by 139,000 year-over-year, exceeding September's 113,000 gain, while the unemployment rate improved to 2.0%. Consumer price inflation moderated to 2.8% in October from 2.9% in September. However, structural concerns persist as youth employment (ages 15-29) declined for the 48th consecutive month. The government expressed optimism about potentially achieving 1 trillion dollars in exports, marking a historic milestone. Despite encouraging macro indicators, consumer sentiment reflects lingering concerns about inflation and actual purchasing power as import price declines have not fully translated to lower retail prices.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI ended lower at 5,290.53, down 0.98%, despite strong foreign investor buying interest in the morning session. Semiconductor stocks including Samsung Electronics (-0.96%) and SK Hynix (-3.03%) faced pressure following Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation announcement. The Korean won-dollar exchange rate settled at 1,336.7 won per dollar. U.S. Treasury yields are expected to peak in early 2027 before stabilizing, prompting investors to increase long-duration bond allocations in anticipation of 2028 rate cuts. The Fed is reducing 2027 FOMC meetings from 8 to 7 decision-making sessions.
sections.Industry & Technology: SFC, a precision organic chemical materials specialist, announced plans to leverage its OLED business expertise while expanding into new sectors including PSF materials, biotech, and semiconductor materials following its upcoming KOSPI listing. The company has accumulated significant technical capabilities and customer trust in high-difficulty OLED blue material production. Historical economic accomplishments were commemorated as industry leaders reflected on past industrialization success in semiconductors, steel, automotive, and shipbuilding sectors. AI glasses are becoming increasingly vulnerable to thermal imaging detection as embedded electronics generate heat from battery and chip operation.
sections.Real Estate: South Korean housing market is showing stabilization signals with apartment subscription rates declining significantly from 7.37:1 last year to 4.5:1 through October, reflecting weakening demand. Initial undersubscribed apartment units are experiencing delayed sales success, with some premium Banpo apartments that missed initial quotas later selling out. Housing price gains in Seoul are decelerating while inventory is expanding, signaling a shift toward buyer-friendly conditions. Celebrity actor Lee Seung-gi, embroiled in a 10.5 billion won jeonse deposit dispute, warned against fraudulent activities in real estate markets, highlighting risks faced by lessees.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve announced its 2027 FOMC schedule with 8 total meetings but only 7 policy rate decisions, with the October meeting focused on monetary policy strategy review. Market expectations show 89.4% probability of a rate increase at the December FOMC meeting. U.S. Treasury yields are anticipated to peak between late 2026 and early 2027 before declining toward potential rate cuts in 2028. International uncertainty remains significant as global markets monitor AI industry developments and potential shifts in U.S. trade and fiscal policies.
sections.AI & Economy: Nvidia's AI ecosystem expansion faces uncertainty following CEO Jensen Huang's resignation, as questions arise about the company's future collaboration strategy and capital flows to partner companies. Domestic investors aggressively accumulated Nvidia shares worth 428.1 billion won following Huang's resignation, viewing the dip as a buying opportunity. Naver faces pressure to transition from traditional advertising-driven revenue toward B2B and cloud businesses, as third-quarter operating profit declined over 20% despite record revenue. Allegations emerged that companies connected to a controversial figure secretly invested in Chinese AI firm DeepSeek while promising advanced Nvidia chip supplies.
sections.Others: South Korea is accelerating legislation on the Digital Asset Basic Law to expand institutional and corporate investor participation in virtual asset markets. Japanese gasoline prices remain lower than Korean prices due to government subsidies and tax cuts, though currency depreciation and rising import costs create fiscal pressures. South Korean retail investors purchased Nvidia stock aggressively during the recent dip, with 428.1 billion won in net purchases during August-13. Defense sector stocks have weakened but maintain structural growth potential from sustained military spending expansion, particularly from U.S.-China competition and allied nations' autonomous defense initiatives.
